target.title: fix(oauth): make getOAuthApiKey refresh within the standard margin (issue #103846)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`getOAuthApiKey` in `src/llm/utils/oauth/index.ts` decided whether to refresh an OAuth token using a raw expiry check (`Date.now() >= creds.expires`). The OAuth manager gate, `hasUsableOAuthCredential` (`src/agents/auth-profiles/credential-state.ts`), decides refresh using a 5-minute margin (`DEFAULT_OAUTH_REFRESH_MARGIN_MS`).

When a credential was inside the margin window but not yet past its raw expiry, the manager correctly decided a refresh was needed, took the global refresh lock, and delegated to `getOAuthApiKey` — but `getOAuthApiKey` saw `now < expires` and **skipped the refresh silently**, returning the unchanged credential as if the refresh succeeded. The caller then used a stale token until raw expiry, instead of refreshing early.

## Evidence

- `src/llm/utils/oauth/index.ts:105` used `if (Date.now() >= creds.expires)` (raw expiry).
- `src/agents/auth-profiles/credential-state.ts:54` `hasUsableOAuthCredential` uses `resolveTokenExpiryState(..., { expiringWithinMs: refreshMarginMs })` with `DEFAULT_OAUTH_REFRESH_MARGIN_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000`.
- Callers `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.ts:213` and `src/agents/sessions/auth-storage.ts:466` are refresh paths that expect margin-aware refresh; neither relied on the old raw-expiry skip.
- New regression test `src/llm/utils/oauth/index.test.ts` covers the margin window (4 min remaining → refresh fires), comfortably-outside (30 min → no refresh), and past-expiry (→ refresh fires).

## Fix

Replaced the raw `Date.now() >= creds.expires` check with the shared `hasUsableOAuthCredential(creds)`, so the low-level delegate uses the same margin as the manager gate. One import, one condition. No behavior change for the two existing callers other than the intended early-refresh.

## Runtime Proof

`scripts/proof-oauth-margin.mjs` mirrors the exact decision functions from `credential-state.ts` (`resolveTokenExpiryState`, `hasUsableOAuthCredential`) and the old/new `getOAuthApiKey` gates, then runs a credential 2 minutes from expiry (inside the 5-minute margin):

```text
$ node scripts/proof-oauth-margin.mjs
MARGIN_MS=300000
creds.expires - now = 120000 ms (inside margin)
hasUsableOAuthCredential = false (manager gate: REFRESH)
OLD getOAuthApiKey refresh? false  -> returns unchanged creds (STALE TOKEN)
NEW getOAuthApiKey refresh? true  -> refreshes within margin (FRESH TOKEN)

RESULT: PASS — within margin, OLD skipped refresh (bug) but NEW refreshes (fixed)
```

The same margin window is covered by the committed regression test `src/llm/utils/oauth/index.test.ts` (no real Anthropic credentials needed).

Closes #103846
